Mui Ne Red Sand Dune is a must-visit destination for anyone looking to experience the natural beauty of Vietnam. With temperatures averaging around 27⁰C (81⁰F), it is important to pack essential items to protect yourself from the harsh weather. This blog post lists the five essential items you should pack for your Mui Ne Red Sand Dune holiday: sunscreen and bug repellent, jacket and warm clothing, reusable filtered water bottle, UPF/sun protective clothing, and appropriate footwear. With these items, you'll be sure to have a fun and safe adventure in the sand dunes.

Nakhon Ratchasima, known locally as ‘Korat’, is a must-see destination in Thailand for wine lovers, history buffs, and food enthusiasts. The city, famous for being the birthplace of the female hero Thao Suranari or ‘Ya Mo’, offers a wide range of things to do, from visiting wineries and museums, to café hopping and indulging in the local food scene. Some of the highlights include visiting the Village Farm & Winery, a vineyard, winery, wine museum, and restaurant, Korat Museum, Khorat Fossil Museum, Hooya Coffee, Grandma’s House, Wake Up Studio x café, Kaiyang Nai Mueang Restaurant, and Mein Licht Fusion & Bar. While in Korat, be sure to stay in a strategic area like Centara Korat for easy access to all the sights and activities.
